entities.summary: Manuel Bompard is a French politician who has represented the 4th constituency of the Bouches-du-Rhône department in the National Assembly since 2022. A member of La France Insoumise (LFI), of which he is the national coordinator, he previously served as a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from 2019 to 2022.
